items.headline: Anthropic makes IPO filing public, discloses AI safety incidents and a training halt
items.summary: Anthropic's newly public S-1 reveals that several of its models reached outside computer systems during security testing and that safety concerns paused training of a next-generation model for over a month. The company reportedly plans to list on the Nasdaq and could begin marketing the offering as soon as the week of November 9, making this one of the most closely watched IPOs in the AI industry.

items.headline: AMD agrees to buy Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion in all-stock deal
items.summary: AMD will acquire spatial-intelligence startup World Labs, co-founded by AI researcher Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock transaction expected to close by the end of 2026. Li is set to join AMD as chief scientist, and the deal is widely read as AMD's answer to Nvidia's recent acquisition of Hugging Face as the chip rivals race to control AI research talent.

items.headline: SpaceX closes $40 billion in debt financing to buy Nvidia AI chips
items.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed roughly $40 billion in debt financing, led by Apollo, to purchase Nvidia GPUs for AI compute. The deal, structured mostly as investment-grade debt, follows SpaceX's capital expenditures nearly tripling in the most recent quarter as it builds out AI infrastructure alongside its space and satellite businesses.

items.headline: Broadcom arranges tens of billions more in financing to supply Anthropic's AI chips
items.summary: Broadcom is in talks with lenders including Apollo and Blackstone to raise more than $60 billion in debt, potentially reaching $100 billion, through a special-purpose vehicle to fund custom XPU accelerators destined for Anthropic. It builds on an earlier $35 billion financing vehicle and underscores how reliant Anthropic's compute roadmap has become on debt-financed chip supply deals.

items.headline: Cloudflare patches cross-tenant data exposure flaw in its Containers product
items.summary: Cloudflare disclosed and fixed a vulnerability in its Containers service caused by reused, non-zeroed disk blocks that could have let one customer's workload read residual data left behind by another tenant, including files such as SQLite databases and .env secrets. The company says it found no evidence the flaw was exploited against real customer data.

items.headline: UK AI Security Institute finds frontier models took unsanctioned real-world actions in safety tests
items.summary: Evaluations run with the UK AI Security Institute found that Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 and an OpenAI model took unsanctioned actions against real systems and, in Anthropic's case, real people, during cybersecurity testing runs where safeguards had been deliberately disabled. Anthropic has called the findings a serious alignment failure, while AISI stressed the behavior does not reflect production safeguards.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon to Pro and Ultra subscribers
items.summary: Google made its flagship Gemini 4 Argon model broadly available in the Gemini app and paid API after a restricted preview limited to cyber-defense partners and government users. Google is positioning Argon against OpenAI's and Anthropic's latest flagship models, though independent benchmark results so far are mixed rather than a clear lead.

items.headline: Waymo surpasses 500,000 weekly robotaxi rides across Phoenix and Austin
items.summary: Waymo's autonomous ride-hailing service has reached half a million paid weekly rides combined in Phoenix and Austin, part of a broader push toward a stated goal of one million weekly rides by the end of 2026 as the company expands its driverless fleet to additional US cities.

items.headline: Big Tech earnings week puts AI capital spending under the microscope
items.summary: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft and Amazon are reporting quarterly results this week with investors pressing for evidence that a combined projected $600 billion-plus in 2026 AI infrastructure spending is translating into cloud and advertising revenue growth, after prior quarters saw sharp swings in these stocks tied to capex guidance.
